About the Game

Flip Gravity.
Survive Everything.

01
🔄
Flip Gravity

Harness the ability to flip gravity at will. Easy to learn, brutally difficult to master — every flip is a high-stakes decision.

02
💀
9 Brutal Levels

Nine uniquely designed levels with their own visual style — warehouses, temples, power stations, outer space, and more.

03
🏆
Epic Boss Fight

Survive all 9 levels and face a final boss that pushes your gravity-flipping skills to the absolute limit.

04
🧩
Puzzles & Reflexes

Squavity collides precision platforming with problem-solving. When do you flip? Every obstacle demands a different answer.

05
🔍
Hidden Secrets

Mysteries are hidden in every level. Explore carefully — secrets only reveal themselves to persistent players.

06

Steam Achievements

Earn Steam Achievements as you push through each level. How many can you unlock before the boss gets you?

The Hero

Meet Squavity!

A square cube navigating a world built to destroy him. His one trick — flipping gravity — turns every hazard into a puzzle waiting to be solved.

Collect all 100 gold pieces and unlock new characters, including the mysterious Gold Character!

↑ Hover to see him flip!

Flips gravity to navigate levels
Transforms appearance between worlds
Unlock new skins with collected gold
Faces a final boss in Level 9
The Levels

9 Levels. Zero Mercy.

LVL 01
The Warehouse

Master the art of gravity flipping. Tight corridors introduce the core mechanic before the real pain begins.

Gravity Tutorial
LVL 02
Aztec Inferno

Rolling boulders, rotating spikes, and fire. Ancient traps meet gravity-flipping chaos in this brutal jungle temple.

Jungle Temple
LVL 03
The Sewer Chamber

Twisting tunnels and hidden dangers. Spike-lined passages demand precision with every flip.

Twisting Tunnels
LVL 04
Power Station

Electricity surges in every direction. Lightning fences and spinning saws in a neon city skyline.

Electric Hazards
LVL 05
Thermal Zone

Rising lava and burning fire. Flip gravity at exactly the right moment or get swallowed by the heat.

Lava & Fire
LVL 06
Moon Base

Zero gravity meets unexpected threats. Navigate a starfield packed with spinning obstacles in every direction.

Zero Gravity
LVL 07
Flash Flood

Master gravity underwater as currents, mines, and torpedoes fight against you.

Underwater
LVL 08
Coal Mine

Darkness, exploding barrels and huge rolling boulders. The penultimate test of everything you've learned.

Darkness & Danger
LVL 09
Boss Fight

One final showdown. Make it through all eight levels — then face what's waiting at the end.

Final Showdown
